Discover our range of diesel generator sets, specifically designed to meet the needs of the demanding data centre industry.
Our powergen solutions include our PowerKit engines offer the widest range on the market, from 18 to 4125 kVA
Baudouin gas engines offer a power range from 63 to 1750 kVA.
